steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: Hahaha... That's no use! Here comes my almighty firepower... Mania bullets!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Mmph! Get down!
Horo brings you down onto the ground, but she is hit by a stray bullet on the shoulder and falls over. The wound is being contaminated rapidly, and the dark mark on her right arm starts burning.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The gun is embedded with Mania Crystals. The bullet was full of contamination!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Not only that. She is overreacting; the contamination is not supposed to spread so fast... Could it be...
Bang... The entire ground is vibrating, like an enormous throbbing heart. At the center of the vibration is none other than the stone altar, from whose patterns sludge is oozing.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh... It's that sensation again, that sickening sensation...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The inheritance is being activated, and the Mania in its vicinity is being reinforced, so is the contamination inflicted by those weapons.

steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: Exactly, that's how it is, that's how things stand... The inheritance is on our side, we are stronger now...

options: You're asking for trouble. You're being corrupted by Mania.

steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: No, No, No... I'm very clear-headed, very much indeed...

steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: They said as long as we can get rid of you, as long as we are able to protect the inheritance, they will make us more weapons, more crystals, to help us win this battle...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: They know only too well your greed for power. They gave you a couple cases of Mania weapons to trick you into coming here and facing the Legion's firepower.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You are nothing more than pawns in this battle against the Legion.
...No, not just this battle. The game of violence where gangs fight and winners rule has been a lie through and through since the very beginning.
Power seized through brute force will only be taken away by greater brute force. No gang can be the master of the Syndicate forever; they can't even be the master of their own fates.

The true master has its presence in this crypt, held in the hand of every gang who desires to become the supreme ruler. The true master is the <color=#fb9259>Mania weapon</color> that everyone is after... It is the <color=#fb9259>mystery arms dealer</color> behind the scene.

He uses the phantom prize of supremacy to stir up fights and is ever increasing the price tag on violence. He is putting one overlord after another on the throne, while he himself is the one true master behind the scene.

steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: ...Mania weapon is the real master. It decides who gets to rule over Syndicate... Gosh, you have a very good point here... Whoever holds the inheritance has control over everything.

steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: Hahaha! Everyone knows that! That's why we took the job!

steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: The inheritance is right here, within our reach. It has never been so close to us. Now... now is the best time!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You wanna steal it? Are you insane? That is the ******* center of Mania. You would be turned into monsters!

steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: What if... what if I turn into a Sinner? Power of this magnitude... who can say no to that?!

steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: You may ask that shorty with the Legion... what has she come here for? Surely she's come here to get her hand on the inheritance before anyone else does?

steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: I understand, I really do. We were born in the Syndicate, and we will die in it. Power is everything, and this holds true for all of us...
